summary: Build and review reliable native and cross-platform mobile applications.
intents: build an offline mode for our iOS app
fix a crash on older Android devices
add push notifications to the React Native app
reduce app startup time on mobile
prepare the app for store submission
not_for: conceptual explanations or comparisons of responsive web design and native apps without mobile implementation or review
backend-only cloud hosting cost estimates unrelated to a mobile client
prerequisites: repository access and the current mobile framework or platform
target operating systems, supported versions, and device constraints
test devices, emulators, or documented verification alternatives recommended
verify: Behaviour is checked on the minimum supported OS versions
Permissions requested match the features that use them
